Name: L.F. ESUS PAPILLON
Information:
**ESUS PAPILLON**

Taking on a form described as being similar to a humanoid butterfly, the graceful ESUS PAPILLON unit relies on subtle sensory illusions to fool others. They are surrounded by a gentle, swirling prismatic light that makes long-range combat against them difficult, and can turn this light into energy to strike others.

Information Sections.Title: ESUS PAPILLON
Information Sections.Text: Taking on a form described as being similar to a humanoid butterfly, the graceful ESUS PAPILLON unit relies on subtle sensory illusions to fool others. They are surrounded by a gentle, swirling prismatic light that makes long-range combat against them difficult, and can turn this light into energy to strike others.

traits.name: Shimmering Illustrator
traits.description:
The frame unit leaves an illusory track behind it, making its movements difficult to track. Opportunity attacks made against it have disadvantage unless the attacker has truesight or uses a sense that doesn’t rely on sight. Blindsight cannot bypass this feature.

Separately, ranged attacks made against the frame unit have disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The frame unit makes two melee weapon attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Ranseur
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 6 (1d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Rainbow Attenuation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The frame unit unleashes two rainbow beams that cross into each other at a point of the frame unit’s choice that it can see within 60 feet. A burst of prismatic light erupts from that point, forcing each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered there to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. Each creature that fails takes 25 (4d10 + 3) psychic damage and becomes sluggish until the start of the frame unit’s next turn.

actions.name: Mach Boost
actions.description: The frame unit doubles its movement speed until the end of its turn and takes the Dash action.
